freeTextLead: [EN] Describe everything freely: work done, quantities, units, time, location, and notes. Later the system can help turn this into structured work lines.
quantitySummaryHint: [EN] Optional quick summary — you can also write all quantities and units in the description above.
classifyLater: [EN] Later, the system can suggest work direction, skills, quantities, and units from your entry. Suggestions must be reviewed before becoming facts.
connectsLater: [EN] This entry can later connect to skills and confirmations

quick.title: Snel bevestigen
quick.subtitle: Eén blik, één tik: de kaart toont de werknemer, de datum, de werkzaamheden en de vaardigheden die u bevestigt. Elke bevestiging is uw echte beslissing en wordt pas vastgelegd wanneer u tikt.
quick.entryOnlyNote: Geen onbevestigde vaardigheden — de tik bevestigt de registratie zelf.
quick.rejectedCard: Afgewezen — {name}. De registratie blijft door de werknemer zelf opgegeven in zijn dagboek.
quick.batchSummaryLead: Eén bevestiging dekt alle onderstaande registraties en wordt vastgelegd als uw beslissing voor elk ervan. Bekijk de lijst voordat u bevestigt.
quick.batchFailed: Niet bevestigd: {count} — open de uitgebreide beoordeling.

noEngagement: [EN] You don't have an active work engagement yet, so there is nothing to log against. Once a manager or client adds you to an organization or project, your journal opens here.
saveError: [EN] Could not save. Please try again.
notesRequiredCopy: [EN] Describe what you worked on — the free text is the proof of record.
foundSummary: [EN] The system found {times} time entries and {activities} possible work directions. Confirm only what is true below.
reviewMetaNote: [EN] Private entry · suggestions reviewed by you. Manager / client confirmation will be added later.
